permissions.page: to show YouTube's player, the box for your link and the videos you watched lately, in a window of its own

permissions.window.overlay: to show a card over your panes with the video's picture, its title and progress, and buttons to play, pause, skip, mute and pick a video

permissions.script:www.youtube.com: to load YouTube's own player in that window

permissions.net:www.youtube-nocookie.com: to show YouTube's player in private mode, which sets no cookies until you play a video

permissions.net:i.ytimg.com: to show the pictures of your videos, in the window and on the card
